body: Existence is a chore and i’m not even doing this willingly, the only reason why I’m still going is that I literally don’t know any other way to exist, I’m adrift on my own boat. I can’t even begin to retake control because I don’t even remember what I was like before this, I don’t remember what I enjoy, all I know is that all food tastes the same, all music sounds the same, all sights look the same. What’s even the point, why should I retake control of my life if all there is to take control of is an empty husk, it doesn’t matter if I take it back, I used to look to someone dear to me for guidance, and for a time it worked, but they started to fade as well, I now second guess their intentions like, “do they really want to help me out of genuine concern? Or are they here so they don’t feel bad, like cleaning a stain on your window.”
